class.name: DialogProxy
class.brief_description: ContextProxy entry held by ActivityManager's dialog list.
class.description: Created by [method Context.show_dialog]. Tracks the dialog's load and attachment; [signal ContextProxy.ready] fires when the dialog has been instantiated and its [code]_on_create[/code] dispatched.

method.name: get_dialog
method.description: Returns the attached [Dialog], or [code]null[/code] while loading.
